owlbear.prompt: single creature, centered, full body side view of an owlbear walking on all fours, (four-legged bear body:1.2) with (dark brown fur:1.3) and big claws, (owl head with brown-feathered face, round yellow eyes and hooked beak:1.25), feathered neck and shoulders. Large fantasy monstrosity, whole body in frame, legs and paws visible
owlbear.negative_append: close-up, portrait, head only, bear head, bear snout, bear ears, wings, perched bird, yellow fur, blonde fur
owlbear.note: SDXL draws either a plain owl or a plain bear from the registry prompt; weight the owl head and forbid the bear head. The bold-colour house style drifts to yellow, so force brown

goblin-warrior.prepend: ugly mean goblin with (green skin:1.2), a wide sharp-toothed grin, long pointed nose and beady red eyes,
goblin-warrior.negative_append: yoda, baby yoda, cute, big round eyes, yellow skin
goblin-warrior.note: juggernaut draws Yoda from 'small goblin'; force a mean green goblin

harpy.prompt: single creature, centered, harpy, a monstrous half-woman half-vulture: a gaunt woman's torso covered in a ragged feathered leather top, grotesque fanged face and matted hair, huge vulture wings where the arms should be, scaly bird legs with talons. Medium monstrosity, full body, A-pose, front view
harpy.negative_append: angel, pretty face, dress, eagle head, vulture head
harpy.note: the registry prompt gives nude women or plain vultures in the manga style; clothe her and keep the monstrous face

young-red-dragon.prompt: (crimson red dragon, red scales all over the body:1.3), single creature, centered, four-legged winged dragon standing with all four feet flat on the ground, (wings spread wide out to the sides:1.2), (long straight tail extended behind:1.2), neck raised, massive swept-back horns, lean adolescent build. Large dragon. full body, three-quarter front view
young-red-dragon.negative_append: blue scales, teal scales, black scales, smoke cloud, red mist, coiled tail, curled tail, tail wrapped around body, sitting, crouching, rearing, folded wings
young-red-dragon.note: the bold-colour style paints the body teal/black with red wings, so force red scales. The default pose curls the tail and sits, which SkinTokens cannot rig: force a straight tail, spread wings and a three-quarter view

constrictor-snake.prompt: single creature, centered, large constrictor snake with patterned brown scales, (whole long body lying flat on the ground in a wide shallow S shape:1.3), head slightly raised at the front, tail trailing behind, (three-quarter view from slightly above:1.2), whole snake small in frame with margin around it. Large beast. full body
constrictor-snake.negative_append: coiled, coils, loops, spiral, curled up, knot, overhead view, rearing, upright, cobra pose, close-up, portrait, head only, cropped, sand, dirt, grass, branch, rocks
constrictor-snake.note: the registry's 'loose S-curve' gives a top-down coiled snake, which image-to-3D stands up as a flat 4.7 m cutout; stretch it out along the ground in a side view so the spine runs along one axis

ghost.prompt: single creature, centered, ghost, a translucent pale spectral human figure in tattered flowing robes, gaunt sorrowful face, (no legs, the lower body tapers into a single wispy tail of mist:1.3), (floating in the air:1.2), arms held slightly out from the body. Medium undead. full body, neutral hovering pose, front view
ghost.negative_append: legs, feet, boots, shoes, trousers, standing on ground, skeleton, skull face, zombie, walking
ghost.note: the registry prompt gives a legged zombie or skeleton; floating needs the legless tapering-tail ghost the custom.ghost rig assumes

centaur-trooper.prompt: single creature, centered, (greek mythology centaur, half man half horse:1.4), (human from the waist up, horse from the waist down, the man's waist joins the horse's chest:1.3), bearded warrior with a breastplate and an arrow quiver on the back, empty open hands, four horse legs standing on the ground, horse tail. Large fey. full body, standing still, three-quarter front view
centaur-trooper.negative_append: (rider, riding, horseback, saddle, reins, bridle:1.5), (horse head, horse ears, horse mane:1.4), minotaur, horns, two creatures, rearing, galloping, bow, spear, weapon in hand
centaur-trooper.note: the registry prompt draws a man riding a horse (2 of 3) or a minotaur; force the human torso in place of the horse's neck
